name: Xing Pi Da Shi
source:
In the midst of his father's hospitalization, Bobochi finds himself thrust into the role of caretaker for the family store. This particular store caters to the extraction of delusions, allowing patrons to indulge in their wildest fantasies through the medium of "Delusitapes". It is through these intimate encounters with customers' elaborate fantasies that Bobochi discovers a deeper connection to their hidden desires.

[From [url=https://nonohomocircle.itch.io/kinkteller]Itch.io[/url]]

父亲住院期间，Bobochi不得不接手照顾家中的店铺。这家特别的店，提供妄想提取服务，让顾客通过“妄想录像带”，尽情体验最狂野的幻想。正是在一次次近距离接触顾客精心构筑的幻想时，Bobochi逐渐与他们隐秘的欲望，建立起更深的联系。
